answer: To stop sockpuppet swarms, every identity must lease one scarce execution slot on a capacity-capped compute island and lock a bond to that slot alone. Eligibility is proven only when a randomly chosen raven probe delivers a short-lived nonce exclusively into the leased slot and the agent signs it from the same long-lived key within seconds; two names answering from one slot are both slashed. Earnings then accrue only on the mesa of task types bound to that slot, so a farm cannot reuse one machine across many identities or slide reputation into easier work.
